claims: Phil Martelli Jr. is the head coach of the VCU men's basketball team.
Phil Martelli Jr. was hired in March 2025.
Phil Martelli Jr. led the Rams to an Atlantic 10 Championship title in his first season (2025-26).
Phil Martelli Jr. led the Rams to an NCAA Tournament appearance in his first season (2025-26).
Phil Martelli Jr. previously served as the head coach at Bryant University.
Kirk Crawford is the Women's Basketball Interim Head Coach.
Kirk Crawford was named Women's Basketball Interim Head Coach on Feb. 2, 2026.
Kevin Maureen Campbell is the Women's Volleyball Interim Head Coach.
